evidence: Artificial intelligence (AI) is being deployed in targeted areas where it can deliver measurable value. For example, our customer service team implemented DAX, an AI-powered assistant that blends advanced technology with human expertise to efficiently resolve routine inquiries
We incorporate AI into certain aspects of our operations, which necessitates ongoing investment in oversight and security measures
The increasing adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools and agentic search technologies may change how customers discover, compare, and purchase products and services
ai_positioning.summary: DLX intègre l'IA de manière ciblée dans ses opérations (notamment via l'assistant DAX pour le service client) tout en reconnaissant les risques associés à l'évolution rapide des technologies d'IA générative sur son modèle commercial et sa compétitivité.
